_about: Public-domain Bernardine of Siena (1380-1444), the Franciscan preacher, for the Word Hoard: his Sermons selected by Nazareno Orlandi and translated by Helen Josephine Robins (Siena, 1920) and the Examples of San Bernardino rendered by Ada Harrison (1926), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
